faq.title: Common questions
faq.subtitle: Practical answers before we start.
faq.pageDescription: How much does a website cost in Latvia? How long does it take? Do you also build apps?

0.q: How much does website development cost in Latvia?
0.a: A simple website starts from €200. A typical business site — €400–1500. Online store — from €800. CRM, app or larger system — from €2000. SEO audit — from €150. AI chatbot — based on scope. Before quoting we always talk to understand what you actually need — consultation is free.

1.q: Do you do more than websites?
1.a: Specialised CRM systems, mobile apps (iOS and Android), online stores, redesigns, SEO audits and optimization, AI chatbots, web apps, APIs and any custom programming. If a business needs something digital — we can build it. Try our AI chatbot: bot.tavswebs.com

2.q: How long does a website take?
2.a: A typical website — 1 to 3 weeks. Redesigns are often faster. SEO — first changes after 2–3 months. Apps and larger projects — 4 to 12 weeks. We agree on a clear timeline before we start.

3.q: What is an SEO audit and optimization?
3.a: We check your site — speed, titles, technical issues and Google visibility. Then you get a clear fix list, and we can implement the fixes too. Ongoing SEO optimization helps you grow in organic search long term.

4.a: Yes. We build iOS and Android apps, plus web apps. Tell us what you need — we'll give a price and timeline after a short talk.

5.q: Where in Latvia do you work?
5.a: Across Latvia — in Riga in person and remotely. We work online, so location isn't a blocker. Meetings in Latvian and English.

6.q: Do I need to sign a long-term contract?
6.a: No. One-off projects — pay after an approved quote. If you need ongoing support or SEO — we agree a monthly plan that can be cancelled with 30 days notice.

7.q: How do we start working together?
7.a: 1) Write to tavswebs@gmail.com, WhatsApp or fill in the contact form. 2) We get in touch and schedule a short call. 3) We send a written quote with plan and price. 4) If it fits — we usually start within 1–2 weeks.

website-cost-latvia.title: How much does a website cost in Latvia?
website-cost-latvia.excerpt: What drives the price and what budget makes sense to start — clear numbers and examples.
website-cost-latvia.intro: One of the most common questions we get: how much does a website cost? The answer isn't a single number — it depends on scope. Here's a clear overview with real ranges in Latvia.

0.heading: Simple website — from €200
paragraphs: A simple business card site or small business page with homepage, services and contact form starts from €200. Includes design, development, mobile version and SEO basics.
This level suits a business that needs a clear online presence without complex functionality.

1.heading: Typical business site — €400–1500
paragraphs: For most small and mid-size businesses, a site for €400–1500 is enough. Usually several content pages, better design, contact form, Google Maps, often a blog section or multilingual support.
Price depends on page count, custom vs template design, and integrations (CRM, booking, etc.).

2.heading: Stores, CRM and larger projects
paragraphs: Online store with products, cart and payments — usually from €800. CRM or business system — from €2000, as it requires detailed specification and custom logic.
Mobile apps, AI chatbots and larger projects are quoted individually.

3.heading: How to get an exact price
paragraphs: Best approach — a short call or filling in the form. We send a written quote with clear price, timeline and what's included — free and with no obligation.
If budget is limited, we say openly what can be done for that amount and what to save for a later phase.

choose-web-developer.title: How to choose a web developer?
choose-web-developer.excerpt: What to check before signing — portfolio, pricing, timelines and red flags.
choose-web-developer.intro: A good developer isn't the one who promises the fastest or cheapest. Here's a practical checklist to pick a partner who actually delivers.

0.heading: Check portfolio and real projects
paragraphs: Does the developer have real clients, not just mock designs? Can you open live sites and check mobile experience?
TavsWebs portfolio is public — browse our work and see for yourself.

1.heading: Clear price and timeline before start
paragraphs: A reliable partner gives a written quote with price, timeline and scope — before work begins.
Watch out for "everything for €99" promises without specification. Often that means hidden costs or disappointing results.

2.heading: Support after launch
paragraphs: Can you get help after the project ends? Can you edit content yourself?
A good solution includes a clear CMS (WordPress-style editor) and a reachable contact — not silence after delivery.

ai-chatbot-business.title: AI chatbot for business — do you need one?
ai-chatbot-business.excerpt: Why more businesses use AI chatbots for customer service and lead collection.
ai-chatbot-business.intro: AI chatbots are no longer future tech — they already work today. Here's when a chatbot makes sense and what it can do for your business.

0.heading: What does an AI chatbot do?
paragraphs: A chatbot answers common questions 24/7 — about pricing, services, hours, availability. It can collect leads, bookings and escalate complex questions to a human.
It doesn't replace all customer service — but frees time from repetitive questions.

1.heading: Who benefits most?
paragraphs: Service businesses, e-commerce, clinics, construction, automotive — anywhere clients ask similar questions before applying.
If you get many WhatsApp or email questions about the same things — a chatbot makes sense.

2.heading: Try our demo
paragraphs: TavsWebs builds custom AI chatbots for websites and WhatsApp. Try our demo: bot.tavswebs.com
If it fits — we can integrate on your site, customize answers for your business and connect lead collection.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.description: How TavsWebs processes personal data when you visit the site, submit a form, or contact us.

0.heading: Who we are
paragraphs: TavsWebs (tavswebs.com) is a digital studio in Latvia for websites, CRM, SEO, apps and AI solutions. Contact: tavswebs@gmail.com, phone +371 25 547 113.
For personal data received through the website, contact forms, email or WhatsApp, TavsWebs is the data controller under the GDPR.

1.heading: What data we collect
paragraphs: Contact and quote forms: name, email, phone (if provided), company (if provided), project description, budget range and other details you include in the message.
Direct communication (email, WhatsApp, phone): information you share so we can reply and continue the conversation.
Technical data: IP address, browser, device type, pages visited and approximate timing — via server logs and, if enabled, analytics (for example hosting or Vercel infrastructure).

2.heading: Legal basis
paragraphs: Legitimate interests — responding to enquiries, preparing quotes and keeping the site secure.
Contract performance or steps prior to a contract — when a project starts or we negotiate services.
Consent — where we ask for it separately (for example optional channels) and you provide it.

3.heading: How we use data
paragraphs: To reply to messages, prepare quotes and provide customer support.
To deliver and improve services, fix technical issues and protect the site from abuse.
We do not sell personal data or use it for independent advertising resale to third parties.

4.heading: Retention and processors
paragraphs: We keep contact requests as long as needed to reply and, if relevant, continue collaboration — typically up to 24 months after last contact, unless a contract or legal duty requires longer.
Trusted providers (email, hosting, forms or analytics) may process data as processors only on our instructions.

5.heading: Cookies and analytics
paragraphs: The site may use strictly necessary cookies and similar technologies for basic functionality (for example language preference).
If we enable measurement or analytics, it is used to improve the site. You can control cookies in your browser settings.

6.heading: Your rights
paragraphs: You may request access, correction, deletion, restriction, objection and data portability — as provided by the GDPR.
To exercise your rights, email tavswebs@gmail.com. We will respond within a reasonable time.
Complaints can be filed with the Latvian Data State Inspectorate: www.dvi.gov.lv.

7.heading: Policy updates
paragraphs: We may update this policy when services, technology or law change. The current version is always on this page with its effective date.

terms.title: Terms of service
terms.description: Terms for using the TavsWebs website and digital services in Latvia.

0.heading: Services
paragraphs: TavsWebs provides website development, ecommerce, redesign, SEO, CRM, mobile apps, custom programming, AI chatbots and related digital services.
Specific scope, deliverables, price and timeline are set in an individual written quote (or contract) before work begins. Website copy and price ranges are informative.

1.heading: Quotes and collaboration
paragraphs: A request via form, email or WhatsApp is not an automatic contract. Work starts when both parties agree on a quote and, where required, an advance payment.
The client provides timely content, feedback and access needed for delivery. Client-side delays may shift the timeline.

2.heading: Payments
paragraphs: Payment terms are defined in the quote — usually an advance before work starts and the balance after acceptance or milestone acceptance.
Prices are in EUR. Unless clearly stated otherwise, they exclude VAT. Late payments may pause work until settled.

3.heading: Intellectual property
paragraphs: After full payment, the client receives rights to use the delivered website or system for their business, unless otherwise agreed in the quote.
Third-party tools, libraries, fonts and licences remain owned by their respective owners. The client is responsible for rights to their own content (text, images, trademarks).

4.heading: Portfolio and publicity
paragraphs: Unless the client objects in writing, TavsWebs may feature the project in portfolio, case studies and marketing materials (name, screenshots, short outcome summary).
If you need confidentiality, agree it in the quote before work starts.

5.heading: Support and warranties
paragraphs: After launch we can fix defects caused on our side within the period defined in the quote.
Post-acceptance changes, new features, third-party outages, hosting issues or client-made changes are usually outside the base fee unless agreed separately.

6.heading: Limitation of liability
paragraphs: TavsWebs is not liable for indirect, incidental or consequential damages (for example lost profit or data loss outside our control).
Maximum liability for a given project is limited to the amount paid by the client for that project, unless mandatory law requires otherwise.

7.heading: Governing law
paragraphs: These terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of Latvia. Disputes are resolved amicably first; otherwise in Latvian courts.
Questions: tavswebs@gmail.com.
